WITH BASE_DATA AS
( SELECT
RC.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RC_ID, R_ID, DECODE(RC.SALARY_NO, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2) AS RC_SALARY_NO, R_SALARY_NO, RC.SALARY_MOUNT AS RC_SALARY_MOUNT, R_SALARY_AMOUNT, RC.GRADE_NO AS RC_GRADE_NO, R_GRADE_NO, RC.PERIOD_NO AS RC_PERIOD_NO, R_PERIOD_NO, RC.DAYS_NO AS RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC.TIME_NO AS RC_TIME, R_TIME, RC.JOBTYPE_NO AS RC_JOBTYPE_NO, R_JOBTYPE_NO, RC.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO AS RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO
FROM RECRUITMENT RC LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" M ON(M.MEMBER_NO = RC.MEMBER_NO) CROSS JOIN
( SELECT
R.RESUME_NO R_ID, DECODE(R.SALARY_NO, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2) AS R_SALARY_NO, R.SALARY_AMOUNT AS R_SALARY_AMOUNT, R.GRADE_NO AS R_GRADE_NO, R.PERIOD_NO AS R_PERIOD_NO, RD.DAYS_NO AS R_DAYS, RD.TIME_NO AS R_TIME, J.JOBTYPE_NO AS R_JOBTYPE_NO, WA.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO AS R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO
FROM RESUME R LEFT JOIN RESUME_DAYSTIME RD ON (R.RESUME_NO = RD.RESUME_NO) JOIN "WORKER" W ON (W.WORKER_NO = R.WORKER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" M ON(M.MEMBER_NO = W.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "RESUME_JOB_TYPE" J ON(J.RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO) LEFT JOIN RESUME_ADDRESS WA ON (R.RESUME_NO = WA.RESUME_NO) WHERE M.MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' AND R.RESUME_DEL_FL = 'N' AND R.RESUME_HIDE_FL = 'N' ORDER BY R.RESUME_NO DESC )
WHERE RC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND RC.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND M.MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY RC.RECRUITMENT_NO DESC ),
MATCH_DAYS_TIME AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC_TIME, R_TIME, (RC_DAYS + R_DAYS ) AS TEST, COUNT(CASE WHEN
((RC_DAYS = R_DAYS) OR (RC_DAYS = 1) OR (R_DAYS = 1)) AND ((RC_TIME = R_TIME) OR (RC_TIME = 1) OR (R_TIME = 1))
THEN 1 END) AS MATCHED_DAY_COUNT FROM (SELECT RC_ID, R_ID, RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC_TIME, R_TIME FROM BASE_DATA GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC_TIME, R_TIME) GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC_TIME, R_TIME ),
MATCH_SDT AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, SUM(TO_NUMBER(MATCHED_DAY_COUNT) ) AS MATCHED_DT_SUM FROM MATCH_DAYS_TIME GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID ),
MATCH_JOB AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, COUNT(CASE WHEN RC_JOBTYPE_NO = R_JOBTYPE_NO THEN 1 END) AS MATCHED_JOB_COUNT FROM (SELECT RC_ID, R_ID, RC_JOBTYPE_NO, R_JOBTYPE_NO FROM BASE_DATA GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_JOBTYPE_NO, R_JOBTYPE_NO) GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_JOBTYPE_NO, R_JOBTYPE_NO ),
MATCH_SJ AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, SUM(TO_NUMBER(MATCHED_JOB_COUNT) ) AS MATCHED_JOB_SUM FROM MATCH_JOB GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID ),
MATCH_ADDRESS AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, COUNT(CASE WHEN RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO THEN 1 END) AS MATCHED_ADDRESS_COUNT FROM (SELECT RC_ID, R_ID, RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO FROM BASE_DATA GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO ),
MATCH_SADD AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, SUM(TO_NUMBER(MATCHED_ADDRESS_COUNT) ) AS MATCHED_ADD_SUM FROM MATCH_ADDRESS GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID ),
COLUMN_MATCHES AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, CASE WHEN (R_GRADE_NO = RC_GRADE_NO) OR (R_GRADE_NO = 1) OR (RC_GRADE_NO = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MATCH_GRADE, CASE WHEN (R_PERIOD_NO = RC_PERIOD_NO) OR (R_PERIOD_NO = 1) OR (RC_PERIOD_NO = 1)THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MATCH_PERIOD, CASE WHEN R_SALARY_NO = RC_SALARY_NO AND R_SALARY_AMOUNT < RC_SALARY_MOUNT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MATCH_SALARY FROM (SELECT RC_ID, R_ID, R_SALARY_NO, RC_SALARY_NO, R_GRADE_NO, RC_GRADE_NO, R_PERIOD_NO, RC_PERIOD_NO , R_SALARY_AMOUNT, RC_SALARY_MOUNT FROM BASE_DATA GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, R_SALARY_NO, RC_SALARY_NO, R_GRADE_NO, RC_GRADE_NO, R_PERIOD_NO, RC_PERIOD_NO , R_SALARY_AMOUNT, RC_SALARY_MOUNT) GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, R_SALARY_NO, RC_SALARY_NO, R_GRADE_NO, RC_GRADE_NO, R_PERIOD_NO, RC_PERIOD_NO , R_SALARY_AMOUNT, RC_SALARY_MOUNT ),
TOTAL_DATA AS ( SELECT MDT.RC_ID, MDT.R_ID FROM MATCH_SDT MDT JOIN MATCH_SJ MJ ON(MDT.R_ID = MJ.R_ID AND MDT.RC_ID = MJ.RC_ID) JOIN MATCH_SADD MADD ON(MDT.R_ID = MADD.R_ID AND MDT.RC_ID = MADD.RC_ID) JOIN COLUMN_MATCHES MM ON(MDT.R_ID = MM.R_ID AND MDT.RC_ID = MM.RC_ID) WHERE (MM.MATCH_GRADE + MM.MATCH_PERIOD + MM.MATCH_SALARY + MJ.MATCHED_JOB_SUM + MDT.MATCHED_DT_SUM + MADD.MATCHED_ADD_SUM) >= 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT
R.RESUME_NO AS "resumeNo", M.MEMBER_EMAIL AS "memberEmail", M.MEMBER_NAME AS "memberName", R.RESUME_TITLE AS "resumeTitle", W.PROFILE_IMG AS "profileImg", W.WORKER_MBTI AS "workerMbti", SUBSTR(M.MEMBER_TEL, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(M.MEMBER_TEL, 4, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(M.MEMBER_TEL, 8, 4) "memberTel", SUBSTR(W.WORKER_ADDRESS, INSTR(W.WORKER_ADDRESS, '^^^') + 3, (INSTR(W.WORKER_ADDRESS, ' ', 1, 2) - (INSTR(W.WORKER_ADDRESS, '^^^') + 3))) "memberAddress", '만 ' || FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), W.WORKER_BIRTHDATE) / 12) || '세' AS "age", TO_CHAR(W.WORKER_BIRTHDATE, 'YYYY') || '년생' AS "workerBirthDate",
LISTAGG(CI.COMPANY_NAME || '-' || CI.CAREER_DESCRIPTION || '&&&' || CASE WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE), START_DATE) / 12) > 0 AND TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE), START_DATE), 12)) > 0 THEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE), START_DATE) / 12) || '년 ' || TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE), START_DATE), 12)) || '개월' WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE), START_DATE) / 12) > 0 THEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE), START_DATE) / 12) || '년 ' WHEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE), START_DATE), 12)) > 0 THEN TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(END_DATE, SYSDATE), START_DATE), 12)) || '개월' ELSE '1개월 미만' END , '^^^') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CI.COMPANY_NAME || '-' || CI.CAREER_DESCRIPTION) OVER(PARTITION BY R.RESUME_NO) AS "carrerStr"
FROM RESUME R LEFT JOIN WORKER W ON (R.WORKER_NO = W. WORKER_NO) JOIN "MEMBER" M ON (W.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN RESUME_CAREER RCA ON (R.RESUME_NO = RCA.RESUME_NO) LEFT JOIN CAREER_INFO CI ON (RCA.CAREER_NO = CI.CAREER_NO)
WHERE R.RESUME_NO IN (SELECT R_ID FROM TOTAL_DATA WHERE RC_ID = #{recruitmentNo}) ORDER BY R.RESUME_NO DESC

WITH BASE_DATA AS
( SELECT

FROM RECRUITMENT RC LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" M ON(M.MEMBER_NO = RC.MEMBER_NO) CROSS JOIN
( SELECT
R.RESUME_NO R_ID, DECODE(R.SALARY_NO, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2) AS R_SALARY_NO, R.SALARY_AMOUNT AS R_SALARY_AMOUNT, R.GRADE_NO AS R_GRADE_NO, R.PERIOD_NO AS R_PERIOD_NO, RD.DAYS_NO AS R_DAYS, RD.TIME_NO AS R_TIME, J.JOBTYPE_NO AS R_JOBTYPE_NO, WA.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO AS R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO
FROM RESUME R LEFT JOIN RESUME_DAYSTIME RD ON (R.RESUME_NO = RD.RESUME_NO) JOIN "WORKER" W ON (W.WORKER_NO = R.WORKER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" M ON(M.MEMBER_NO = W.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "RESUME_JOB_TYPE" J ON(J.RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO) LEFT JOIN RESUME_ADDRESS WA ON (R.RESUME_NO = WA.RESUME_NO) WHERE M.MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' AND R.RESUME_DEL_FL = 'N' AND R.RESUME_HIDE_FL = 'N' ORDER BY R.RESUME_NO DESC )
WHERE RC.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND RC.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND M.MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY RC.RECRUITMENT_NO DESC ),
MATCH_DAYS_TIME AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC_TIME, R_TIME, (RC_DAYS + R_DAYS ) AS TEST, COUNT(CASE WHEN
((RC_DAYS = R_DAYS) OR (RC_DAYS = 1) OR (R_DAYS = 1)) AND ((RC_TIME = R_TIME) OR (RC_TIME = 1) OR (R_TIME = 1))
THEN 1 END) AS MATCHED_DAY_COUNT FROM (SELECT RC_ID, R_ID, RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC_TIME, R_TIME FROM BASE_DATA GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC_TIME, R_TIME) GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_DAYS, R_DAYS, RC_TIME, R_TIME ),
MATCH_SDT AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, SUM(TO_NUMBER(MATCHED_DAY_COUNT) ) AS MATCHED_DT_SUM FROM MATCH_DAYS_TIME GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID ),
MATCH_JOB AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, COUNT(CASE WHEN RC_JOBTYPE_NO = R_JOBTYPE_NO THEN 1 END) AS MATCHED_JOB_COUNT FROM (SELECT RC_ID, R_ID, RC_JOBTYPE_NO, R_JOBTYPE_NO FROM BASE_DATA GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_JOBTYPE_NO, R_JOBTYPE_NO) GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_JOBTYPE_NO, R_JOBTYPE_NO ),
MATCH_SJ AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, SUM(TO_NUMBER(MATCHED_JOB_COUNT) ) AS MATCHED_JOB_SUM FROM MATCH_JOB GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID ),
MATCH_ADDRESS AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, COUNT(CASE WHEN RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO THEN 1 END) AS MATCHED_ADDRESS_COUNT FROM (SELECT RC_ID, R_ID, RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO FROM BASE_DATA GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, RC_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO, R_WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO ),
MATCH_SADD AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, SUM(TO_NUMBER(MATCHED_ADDRESS_COUNT) ) AS MATCHED_ADD_SUM FROM MATCH_ADDRESS GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID ),
COLUMN_MATCHES AS ( SELECT R_ID, RC_ID, CASE WHEN (R_GRADE_NO = RC_GRADE_NO) OR (R_GRADE_NO = 1) OR (RC_GRADE_NO = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MATCH_GRADE, CASE WHEN (R_PERIOD_NO = RC_PERIOD_NO) OR (R_PERIOD_NO = 1) OR (RC_PERIOD_NO = 1)THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MATCH_PERIOD, CASE WHEN R_SALARY_NO = RC_SALARY_NO AND R_SALARY_AMOUNT < RC_SALARY_MOUNT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MATCH_SALARY FROM (SELECT RC_ID, R_ID, R_SALARY_NO, RC_SALARY_NO, R_GRADE_NO, RC_GRADE_NO, R_PERIOD_NO, RC_PERIOD_NO , R_SALARY_AMOUNT, RC_SALARY_MOUNT FROM BASE_DATA GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, R_SALARY_NO, RC_SALARY_NO, R_GRADE_NO, RC_GRADE_NO, R_PERIOD_NO, RC_PERIOD_NO , R_SALARY_AMOUNT, RC_SALARY_MOUNT) GROUP BY RC_ID, R_ID, R_SALARY_NO, RC_SALARY_NO, R_GRADE_NO, RC_GRADE_NO, R_PERIOD_NO, RC_PERIOD_NO , R_SALARY_AMOUNT, RC_SALARY_MOUNT ),

SELECT COUNT(R_ID) FROM TOTAL_DATA WHERE RC_ID = #{recruitmentNo} GROUP BY RC_ID
